mainText: Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! At 8 PM, we have beautiful clear skies over Verona City Hall with a full moon out tonight. Even better, look to the west southwest over Mount Horeb at 9:40 PM to catch the space station passing by for one minute, staying low near the horizon. We will drop to a low of 70 degrees tonight with absolutely no rain in sight.
